title: Kara:
title_short: Kara · Perfect Mom vs Real Mom
headline: The life a mom imagines with a baby, then the real one: every calm moment from the dream gets interrupted by a crying baby.
story: Momcozy's creative script, shot as written. Part 1, the dream: pink pajamas, slow skincare, a sleeping baby in a wrap, breakfast, Pilates in a cute set, a book on the couch. Part 2, reality: black hoodie, messy hair, and every activity ends the same way, she hears the baby and walks out of frame.

The joke is the rhythm. The dream half is slow and soft. A black <q>Reality…</q> card stops everything. The reality half is fast, each beat ends on an empty frame. It closes on her leaning over the baby, smiling: real life, still love.

Loops: L1 “What did she imagine?” opens at 0:00 and is answered by 0:12. L2 “What is the reality?” opens on the black card at 0:12 and closes on her reaching the baby at 0:25. Stakes: every mom's daily plan versus one crying baby.
do: Open on the title text already on screen at 0:00 over a blurred shot. The blur clears by 0:02.
Dream half slow and soft. Reality half fast. Every reality beat ends on an empty frame.
Mirror the beats: skincare, baby, breakfast, Pilates, reading, then vacuum.
Baby on camera in the dream beats and at the end (client rule).
Use the title cards word for word: “What I Imagined Life with a Baby Would Be Like” and “Reality…”.
dont: No logo, no name, no plain title card on black at 0:00.
Do NOT use any sound from these clips: it is the director talking. Music and SFX only.
No freeze frames. Every shot keeps moving.
Do not use the parts of IMG_9397 where the boys climb in front of the camera in the dream half.
No products in this one. No product text.

footage.note: 15 vertical iPhone clips, IMG_9392 to IMG_9408. Pink pajamas = the dream. Black hoodie = reality.

bp_intro: All times are mm:ss in each source clip (vertical iPhone, 4K HEVC, about 24 fps), read off keyframes, good to about 1 s. Frames are real frames from the clips. The only voice on these clips is the director off camera, so there is no spoken line in this cut.

rows.visual: IMG_9401.MOV 01:16 to 01:21: she pats her face, peaceful. Start with a soft blur on the picture. The blur clears by 0:02.
rows.motion: Title text on frame 1: What I Imagined Life with a Baby Would Be Like Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third, white Inter Bold, soft shadow. It stays up until 0:03. No logo, no name.
rows.voice: No voice. Do not use any sound from this clip: it is the director talking.
rows.music: Soft, dreamy music starts on frame 1. Light and happy.

rows.frame_alt: Kara in pink pajamas in the hallway light, baby wrapped against her chest in a pink blanket, looking down with a soft smile.
rows.visual: IMG_9392.MOV 00:10 to 00:13: she rocks the baby in the wrap by the window light. Baby on camera.

rows.frame_alt: Kara at the stove in pink, baby in the wrap on her chest, stirring a pan with a wooden spoon.
rows.visual: IMG_9395.MOV 00:02 to 00:05 stirring the pan with the baby on her chest. Then IMG_9396.MOV 00:17 to 00:20: she eats at the table, baby on her chest, smiling.
rows.voice: No voice. IMG_9396.MOV has the director talking at 00:00 to 00:09. Music only.

rows.frame_alt: Kara in a fitted blue workout set on a mat in the living room, deep squat, hands together.
rows.visual: IMG_9400.MOV 00:50 to 01:09: pick 2 fast moves (arms up at 00:51, the squat with hands together at 01:06).

rows.frame_alt: Kara cross-legged on the grey couch, baby on her lap, a book open on her knees, smiling.
rows.visual: IMG_9397.MOV 01:43 to 01:46: she reads with the baby on her lap. Keep it to the calm frames only. The boys run in at other times: do not use those parts here.

rows.motion: Title text on black: <q>Reality…</q> Center, white Inter Bold. Hold 1 s. Hard cut in, hard cut out.
rows.sfx: Record scratch or a short music stop on the cut to black.
rows.music: Music stops dead on the cut. Silence on the card.

rows.frame_alt: Kara in a black hoodie scrambling out of bed, hair messy, grey sheets.
rows.visual: IMG_9402.MOV 00:14 to 00:19: she is asleep, then jolts and climbs out of bed. Then IMG_9403.MOV 00:05 to 00:09: she walks past the sink and out. No skincare.
rows.voice: No voice. Mute the director's “and action”.
rows.sfx: Baby crying SFX from the library, starts on her waking.
rows.music: New music: fast, funny, a little chaotic.

rows.frame_alt: Kara in the black hoodie pouring cereal from a red box into a steel bowl at the counter.
rows.visual: IMG_9404.MOV 00:23 to 00:27 she pours cereal fast. Then 00:31 to 00:33: the bowl alone on the counter, she is gone. If her exit is on the clip, use it. Check on scrub.

rows.frame_alt: Kara in the black hoodie and pink sweatpants, arms up in a stretch on the mat, eyes closed.
rows.visual: IMG_9406.MOV 00:13 to 00:19: arms up, then she looks over and walks out of frame. End on the empty mat.
rows.voice: No voice. Mute the director at 00:07.

rows.frame_alt: Kara leaning over the baby in a bouncer seat, touching her face.
rows.visual: IMG_9407.MOV 00:16 to 00:30, cut tight: she reads on the couch with the boys climbing on her, gets up at 00:25, and at 00:28 leans over the baby in the bouncer. Baby on camera.
rows.voice: No voice. The director says “you can hear the baby crying” at 00:16. Mute it.

rows.frame_alt: Kara in the black hoodie running off, the vacuum standing alone on the navy rug.
rows.visual: IMG_9408.MOV 00:34 to 00:45: she vacuums the rug, parks it at 00:41 and runs off. End on the vacuum alone.
rows.sfx: Baby crying SFX, then it stops when she is gone.
rows.music: Music hits a small button on the empty frame.

rows.visual: End card: MOMCOZY wordmark in Cozy Chestnut #6A2B3A on Warm Cream #FEF9F6.
rows.motion: First logo in the whole video. Short fade in.

client_note: Why this matters: Momcozy's biggest reels lately are mom humor and real mom life, not product demos. This is pure relatable humor, so the rhythm is the whole video.
